interpretation: A benchmark-only one-key Durable Object serving a local append-only SQLite fact log and its latest value projection reduced warm-actor pointed-read p99 substantially versus a full Poneglyph graph query in this local 128-concurrency sample. It also completed a single-hot-key read wave with p99 below 10 ms. This changes the coordination atom: it does not provide Datalog joins, graph-wide transactions or a cross-key snapshot. These are local RPC timings, not hosted evidence.
limitations: Three one-wave local Miniflare trials; owner actors were recently used for seeding, not cold-started between seed and read.
Single-key owner preserves only per-key history/atomicity. It is not a Poneglyph replacement for graph-wide transactions or arbitrary query algebra.
No injected actor failures, sustained/open-loop traffic, network path, Cloudflare placement or hosted p99.
A one-hot-key 128-request wave does not prove arbitrary sustained throughput for that actor.
